text:
Aisha Kapoor: Quick sync 1: new int8 canary showing parse-error regression in funcall paths (~0.31%). Raw streams suggest replica merge is cutting inside escape sequences / string literals.
Dan Li: sample?
Aisha Kapoor: snippet from two replicas: 
```
[replica-A] ...\"note\": \"Session started at 2026-03-21 14:
[replica-B] 22\", \"id\": 9001} ...
```
Naive concat sometimes yields an extra backslash or an unterminated quote and json.loads fails.
Priya Patel: timing shift from PTQ/int8 causing tokenization boundary moves. I'd prefer not to change public API.
Jin Park: low-risk mitigations: (1) arbiter injects a tiny sentinel like `<RWD-SPLIT>` between replica fragments and strip on reassembly, or (2) NDJSON per toolcall (line-delimited) so we can parse incrementally.
Dan Li: sentinel is easiest short term. Also add a client reassembly helper that only performs conservative fixes: brace balance, safe close quotes, detect truncated escape `\"` at end-of-chunk and try to stitch. Always log attempted fixes.
Aisha Kapoor: reassembly heuristic prototype: 
```
def reassemble(chunks):
  s = ''.join(chunks)
  if json_ok(s): return s
  if truncated_escape_at_end(chunks): s = close_escape(s); if json_ok(s): return s
  if braces_balanced(s) and quote_pairs_even(s): return s
  return None  # trigger non-streaming retry
```
Priya Patel: please be conservative on automatic fixes 1 prefer retry if not provably safe. Emit telemetry `reassembly_attempted` with outcome labels (fixed|retry|failed) and tags: model, quant (fp16/ptq/int8), canary-id.
Jin Park: also add fragment TTL: if fragments for same call arrive >180ms apart from different replicas, treat as cross-response and prefer retry instead of merge.
canary-bot: boundary-sentinel canary enabled on eng-ml staging (5309991150) at 1% traffic :rocket:
Dan Li: I'll add a dashboard slice for parse-fail rate by quant and by merge-method (concat|sentinel|ndjson) and instrument `frag_ttl_exceeded`.
Aisha Kapoor: runbook: enable sentinel mode for 1% -> ship reassembly lib with conservative repairs + logging -> non-streaming fallback when reassembly returns None -> emit telemetry. Drop first-hour snapshot here once live. :thumbsup:
